title: A Johns Hopkins Bayview Hospital Employee in Baltimore Reportedly Uploaded Patient Data to an Unapproved AI Tool
summary: An employee at Johns Hopkins Bayview Medical Center in Baltimore, Maryland, reportedly uploaded a spreadsheet containing patient information to an unapproved public AI tool. The hospital notified 3,182 patients of potential exposure, sought deletion of the data, and reinforced staff training. The tool and its developer were not identified; further disclosure or misuse has not been established.
